findings.detail: Both PNGs byte-identical SHA256 77732F91947F3A6D88A17D73A5CC4634F4FBC866CEA73CA2D2B5E536EBBE56B9 and print Map #2. Manifest DAT hashes differ. A distinct floor endpoint cannot be approved from these packets.
Both PNGs byte-identical SHA256 4D4FE7466988E203F20C0F3D032659A16746BC640B6A310B0594A2A884F853AA. They show the Beaucedine/Qu'Bia upper layout. Lower floor cannot be independently checked.
La Theine printed entrance code 2 belongs to packet ordelle3, and code3 to ordelle2. Code numbers are not map key suffixes.

Two Carpenters' Landing entrance codes do not imply two map floors. landing2 artwork labels Northern San d'Oria. Isolated northwest Jugner component must be retained; actual paired Landing endpoint still needs stronger evidence.
King Ranperre's Tomb arrival is exit-only into Jugner according to Horizon Wiki. Inventory location is approximate artwork throat; no reverse traversal approval.
Horizon description explicitly says southern areas require drops through southwest/southeast holes on Map2. Matching printed letters alone cannot establish reversible passage.

Destination titles and leader arrows were excluded as exit locations. Glyph centers can differ from actual stair/tunnel throats; reviewer endpoint coordinates remain approximate unless corrected later.

All20 pilot PNGs inspected before opening any worker candidate outputs. No game running; no record traversal-verified. Inventory includes visible internal letter transitions and relevant transport docks but does not treat ordinary NPC or warp icons as walking exits.

Original PNGs show special tiny apparatus spurs on Ordelle floor14 (ordelle3), Eldieme floor14 (eldieme1), FeiYin floor14 (feiyin2); replacement artwork reuses larger layouts. Native originals disambiguate: upper Ordelle is floor15/ordelle4; Eldieme printedMap2 is floor16/eldieme3; lower FeiYin is floor15/feiyin3. Duplicate replacement textures are not by themselves a decoding bug.

Initial northwest Jugner isolation note was precautionary. Required enclosed component is Tomb arrival/tomb_access; do not label Carpenters Landing printed1 itself isolated solely from the destination label. Monastic has north, central and east components. Eldieme floor16 has separate northwest, west and southwest branches; Batallia6 is island and7 northwest.

inventory_stage_note: Original20 maps inventoried before candidate access. Three added maps inventoried from native/original and replacement artwork after parent expanded pilot. Original overlay observations preserved; native floor findings below supersede apparent duplicate-overlay assignments.
